goal: P01/P02 legal source acquisition in backend/services/research_factory/

features_delivered: Provider connectors with rights/robots/licensing validation: Built BaseProviderConnector and ProviderRegistry supporting official heritage registries (UNESCO, MOWCAP, DSVH, Nom Foundation, National Museum, HMCC), open scholarly metadata (DOI, Crossref), with configurable rate limits, robots.txt policies, and domain allowlists.

Strict no-paywall-bypass enforcement: Detects subscription barriers on commercial academic publishers (JSTOR, Elsevier, Springer, etc.) and strictly rejects unauthorized scraper bypass attempts, bypass headers (X-Bypass-Paywall, X-Proxy-Scrape), and User-Agent spoofing (PaywallBypassError).
Robots.txt compliance: Evaluates paths against robots.txt rules and disallows scraping of restricted/private directories (RobotsDisallowedError).

Forbidden pirate & shadow domain blocking: Enforces explicit denylist blocking unauthorized pirated scan libraries and darkweb repositories (Sci-Hub, LibGen, pirated-scans.org) with ForbiddenDomainError.

Authority verification and anti-impersonation: Maps official institutions to canonical domains and detects suspicious personal blogs (blogspot, wordpress, etc.) spoofing museum identities (AuthorityImpersonationError).
Malware & document sanitization: Inspects payload magic bytes and rejects executable binaries (Windows PE MZ, Linux ELF, Shell script) disguised as PDFs or documents (MaliciousPayloadError).

Rights action matrix & negative abuse defense: Public domain and open licenses (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-NC) cleared with display/derivative permissions; attempting to ingest full digital scans of copyrighted works without permission is strictly blocked (ForbiddenCopyrightedScanError) while bibliographic metadata citations are permitted with excerpt redaction (ALLOWED_METADATA_ONLY).
Strict rule - Unknown rights != granted: Ambiguous or unreviewed rights are strictly quarantined (QUARANTINED_PENDING_REVIEW) and blocked from database ingestion until cleared by human rights review.

P01 Candidate discovery & deduplication: Performs deterministic URL canonicalization (stripping UTM tracking and session queries), DOI and ISBN normalization, candidate intra-batch deduplication, and database deduplication against existing HistoricalSource records.

P02 Legal acquisition & database persistence: Persists approved sources into PostgreSQL HistoricalSource table idempotently with verification_status ('accessible' or 'rights_restricted'), deterministic SHA-256 checksums, and excerpts.

test_details.name: test_provider_connectors_registry_and_policies
test_details.assertion: Verifies built-in authorized connectors (UNESCO, MOWCAP, DSVH, Nom Foundation, National Museum, DOI, Crossref), domain extraction, and connector lookup.

test_details.name: test_robots_txt_compliance_enforced
test_details.assertion: Verifies paths disallowed by robots.txt (/restricted/*) are deterministically blocked with RobotsDisallowedError.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_forbidden_copyrighted_scan_blocked
test_details.assertion: Required negative abuse test: Attempting to acquire or ingest a full scanned PDF of an in-copyright book without license is strictly blocked with ForbiddenCopyrightedScanError, while metadata citation is allowed with excerpt redaction.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_paywall_bypass_blocked
test_details.assertion: Verifies scraping behind paywalls or passing bypass evasion headers (X-Bypass-Paywall) or spoofed User-Agent is blocked with PaywallBypassError.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_forbidden_pirate_domain_blocked
test_details.assertion: Verifies pirate scan repositories and shadow libraries (Sci-Hub, LibGen) are strictly blocked with ForbiddenDomainError.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_unapproved_source_quarantined
test_details.assertion: Verifies sources from unapproved/unverified domains are quarantined with QUARANTINED_PENDING_REVIEW and blocked from DB ingestion.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_malicious_payload_sanitized
test_details.assertion: Verifies executable binaries (PE MZ, ELF, shell script) or corrupt binaries masked as PDFs are rejected with MaliciousPayloadError.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_authority_impersonation_detected
test_details.assertion: Verifies personal blogs spoofing official museum authority (Bảo tàng Lịch sử Quốc gia on blogspot.com) are detected and blocked with AuthorityImpersonationError.

test_details.name: test_unknown_rights_never_converted_to_granted
test_details.assertion: Verifies ambiguous/unknown rights are strictly quarantined and never auto-granted.

test_details.name: test_p01_candidate_discovery_and_deduplication
test_details.assertion: Verifies URL canonicalization (stripping tracking params), DOI/ISBN normalization, and batch deduplication.

test_details.name: test_p02_source_acquisition_and_db_ingestion_idempotency
test_details.assertion: Verifies ingestion of approved sources into HistoricalSource, SHA-256 checksumming, and idempotent re-ingestion.
